# Navigation

Tabs, segmented control, accordion, breadcrumbs, pagination, stepper and the mega menu.

[Tabs](#tabs) · [Segmented](#segmented) · [Accordion](#accordion) · [Breadcrumbs](#breadcrumbs) · [Pagination](#pagination) · [Stepper](#stepper) · [MegaMenu](#megamenu)

### Tabs

An accessible tab list. Optionally renders the active panel too.

```ts
import { Tabs } from '@/kit/components/nav/Tabs'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` *(required)* | `{ id: string; label: ReactNode; count?: number }[]` |  | The tabs. |
| `value` *(required)* | `string` |  | Id of the active tab. |
| `onChange` *(required)* | `(id: string) => void` |  | Called with the id of the chosen tab. |
| `panels` | `Record<string, ReactNode>` |  | Content per tab id; only the active one is rendered. |
| `ariaLabel` *(required)* | `string` |  | Accessible name of the tab list. |

```tsx
<Tabs ariaLabel="Portfolio" value={tab} onChange={setTab}
  items={[{ id: 'holdings', label: 'Holdings', count: 8 }, { id: 'activity', label: 'Activity' }]}
  panels={{ holdings: <Holdings />, activity: <Activity /> }} />
```

- ← → Home End move between tabs; only the active tab is in the tab order (roving tabindex).

### Segmented

A compact single-choice switch, such as chart ranges or list/grid.

```ts
import { Segmented } from '@/kit/components/nav/Segmented'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` *(required)* | `{ value: T; label: ReactNode; icon?: ReactNode; disabled?: boolean }[]` |  | The choices. |
| `value` *(required)* | `T` |  | Selected value. |
| `onChange` *(required)* | `(value: T) => void` |  | Called with the chosen value. |
| `ariaLabel` *(required)* | `string` |  | Accessible group name. |
| `mono` | `boolean` |  | Mono uppercase style for ranges such as 1D 1W 1M. |
| `block` | `boolean` |  | Full width, equal-width options. |

```tsx
<Segmented ariaLabel="Range" mono value={range} onChange={setRange} options={['1M', '3M', '1Y'].map((v) => ({ value: v, label: v }))} />
```

- A radio group: arrow keys move and select; disabled options are skipped.

### Accordion

A list of disclosure sections built on native `<details>`.

```ts
import { Accordion } from '@/kit/components/nav/Accordion'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` *(required)* | `{ id: string; title: ReactNode; content: ReactNode }[]` |  | The sections. |
| `name` | `string` |  | Shared name: only one section is open at a time. |
| `defaultOpen` | `string` |  | Id of the section open at first. |

```tsx
<Accordion name="faq" items={[{ id: 'a', title: 'Is there a free plan?', content: <p>Yes.</p> }]} />
```

### Breadcrumbs

A trail of links to the current page.

```ts
import { Breadcrumbs } from '@/kit/components/nav/Breadcrumbs'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` *(required)* | `{ label: string; to?: string }[]` |  | Trail, last item is the current page and is not a link. |

```tsx
<Breadcrumbs items={[{ label: 'Markets', to: '/markets' }, { label: 'AAPL' }]} />
```

- Rendered as an ordered list inside `nav[aria-label="Breadcrumb"]`; the last item has `aria-current="page"`.

### Pagination

Previous / next and numbered pages with ellipses (1 … 4 5 [6] 7 8 … 20).

```ts
import { Pagination } from '@/kit/components/nav/Pagination'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `page` *(required)* | `number` |  | Current page, starting at 1. |
| `pageCount` *(required)* | `number` |  | Total pages. Renders nothing when there is only one. |
| `onChange` *(required)* | `(page: number) => void` |  | Called with the chosen page. |

```tsx
<Pagination page={page} pageCount={12} onChange={setPage} />
```

### Stepper

Progress through a multi-step flow.

```ts
import { Stepper } from '@/kit/components/nav/Stepper'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `steps` *(required)* | `string[]` |  | Step names. |
| `current` *(required)* | `number` |  | Index of the current step, starting at 0. |

```tsx
<Stepper steps={['Account', 'Profile', 'Plan']} current={1} />
```

- Labels of non-current steps are hidden on narrow screens.

### MegaMenu

The primary navigation list with a mega panel per entry. It knows nothing about your data: entries and the side column come in as props.

```ts
import { MegaMenu } from '@/kit/components/nav/MegaMenu'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `entries` *(required)* | `NavEntry<P, F>[]` |  | Menu structure. An entry with `mega` has a panel of `columns`; one without is a plain link. Types are in `kit/components/nav/navTypes.ts`. |
| `renderSide` | `(ctx: { entry; item; close }) => ReactNode` |  | Content of the side column. `item` is the link under the pointer or focus, or null. Return a default card when it is null. |

```tsx
<MegaMenu entries={NAV} renderSide={({ entry, item, close }) => item ? <Preview item={item} onNavigate={close} /> : <Featured entry={entry} />} />
```

- Opens on hover (with a short intent delay), click, or ↓ on the trigger; Esc closes and returns focus to the trigger.
- Links can carry any `preview` data; the kit hands it back through `renderSide` untouched.
- The page behind the panel is dimmed with a `mega-open` class on `<body>`. Styles: `kit/styles/mega.css`.
